title: Swarm Reliability Fix — Sprint Selection + Invoica Smoke Test Removal
description: Two P0 fixes identified in 2026-03-19 protocol audit. (1) Autonomous Claude picks wrong sprint to run — picks already-shipped sprint files (e.g. sprint-186 re-run, 0 tasks executed) because STEP 1 has no explicit 'find next unshipped sprint' instruction. Fix: add mandatory 2-command sequence to autonomous-prompt.txt STEP 1. (2) orchestrate-agents-v2.ts has Invoica-specific smoke test hardcoded (checks /v1/health, /v1/invoices, /v1/settlements on localhost:3001) — always fails in Kognai context, wastes 30s per run, floods Telegram with false FAILED alerts. Fix: null out postSprintSmokeTest() to a no-op (3-line body replacement). FP-007 risk on task 205-02: file is 3042 lines — SURGICAL ONLY, replace function body only. Both tasks are safe for swarm if instructions are followed precisely.

tasks.title: Fix autonomous-prompt.txt STEP 1 — add explicit next-unshipped-sprint selection
tasks.description:
Modify autonomous-prompt.txt. Find the block that starts with 'STEP 1 — PLAN (you, Sonnet — do NOT spawn opus):'. It currently reads:

STEP 1 — PLAN (you, Sonnet — do NOT spawn opus):
  Read: ~/kognai/workspace/sprint-brief.md (primary context — ~2500 tokens)
  Also check: git log --oneline -5 (verify brief is current)
  DO NOT read MEMORY.md or progress.md unless the brief is stale/wrong.
  Determine: What is the next Sprint that needs building?
  Design: Sprint number, sprint name, task list, acceptance criteria.

Replace that entire block with this exact text:

STEP 1 — PLAN (you, Sonnet — do NOT spawn opus):
  Read: ~/kognai/workspace/sprint-brief.md (primary context — ~2500 tokens)
  Also check: git log --oneline -10 (verify brief is current)
  DO NOT read MEMORY.md or progress.md unless the brief is stale/wrong.

  Find next unshipped sprint (MANDATORY — run these 2 commands before designing):
    1. LAST_SHIPPED=$(git log --oneline | grep -oE 'Sprint [0-9]+:' | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
       → gives the last sprint number that was committed to git
    2. ls ~/kognai/workspace/sprints/ | sort
       → lists all sprint JSON files on disk
    The NEXT sprint to run = the LOWEST sprint number that:
      - has a JSON file in workspace/sprints/
      - does NOT appear in git log as 'Sprint NNN:' (i.e. not yet shipped)
    If no pre-written file exists: create sprint-NNN.json where NNN = LAST_SHIPPED + 1
    NEVER re-run a sprint that already appears in git log.

  Design: Sprint number, sprint name, task list, acceptance criteria.
tasks.context: Sprint 205. Root cause of swarm re-running sprint-186 (already shipped): STEP 1 says 'Determine: What is the next Sprint that needs building?' with no deterministic method. Claude read a stale brief and picked sprint-186 JSON off disk. The fix adds a mandatory 2-command cross-reference between git log (shipped) and ls sprints/ (on disk) to find the actual gap. File is plain text — safe for swarm, no FP-007 risk.

tasks.title: Null out postSprintSmokeTest() in orchestrate-agents-v2.ts — SURGICAL BODY REPLACEMENT ONLY
tasks.context: Sprint 205. The postSprintSmokeTest() function (lines ~2966-3023) checks localhost:3001/v1/health, /v1/invoices, /v1/settlements — Invoica-specific endpoints that do not exist in Kognai. Every swarm run wastes 30s waiting + fires false Telegram alerts. Fix is a body-only replacement, preserving the function signature so the call site at line 2907 remains valid. FP-007: if swarm attempts full-file rewrite, dual supervisor will catch destructive rewrite and REJECT. Do not retry — skip and note for manual fix.

tasks.title: Validate sprint-205 — compile check + confirm smoke test disabled
tasks.description: Create scripts/validate-sprint-205.ts. New file, <50 lines. Two checks: (1) TypeScript compile: execSync('npx tsc --noEmit scripts/orchestrate-agents-v2.ts', {stdio:'pipe'}) — assert exit code 0 (or same error count as before, since there are pre-existing errors); (2) Read autonomous-prompt.txt and assert it contains the string 'NEVER re-run a sprint that already appears in git log'; (3) Read scripts/orchestrate-agents-v2.ts and assert it does NOT contain the string 'v1/invoices' (confirms smoke test body was removed). Print PASS/FAIL per check. Exit 0 on all pass.
tasks.context: Sprint 205. Standard gate validator. The string checks are deterministic — no need for a real swarm run to validate. Quick compile check ensures the surgical orchestrator edit didn't break TypeScript.
